newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo Prva Preduzetnicka Banka stock sold out.
newsitem.headline: Yugo Prva Preduzetnicka Banka stock sold out.

text.p: Yugoslav commercial bank Prva Preduzetnicka banka has sold out its entire 750,000 dinar ($132,335) issue listed last week on the Belgrade bourse, the Belgrade Stock Exchange (BSE) reported on Monday.
"This has only been a primary sale of a part of the banks' issue," BSE spokesman Milko Stimac told Reuters.

The listed and sold ordinary shares were part of the bank's 9th issue which totalled three million dinars and represented 4.89 percent of the bank's entire founding capital. All shares had a 1,500 dinars face value, Stimac said.

The Yugoslav Securities Commission, in an attempt to foster development of the local financial market, decided late last year to launch a regulation under which a share issue is considered successful only if the entire issue is sold out, part of it on the bourse.
According to the bourse report, Prva Preduzetnicka Banka also listed and sold out another 1.5 million dinars in its stock issued several years ago.
"This was supposed to be a form of secondary trading, but both this and the primary sale were prearranged deals, with buyers known in advance," a trader said.
Shares, of 1,500 dinars face value, were sold at par. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
